views.all: comparable cells (all classes except REF_ERR, NONDET, NOOUT, SETUP_ERR)
views.clean_strict: comparable, clean_input (every input E0-equal), minus post-timeout cascades
views.clean_E2: comparable, clean_level in E0..E2, minus post-timeout cascades
views.common_clean_E2: A11 (2026-10-05): cells in the clean_E2 view of all five core conf_1x engines and both drift pandas versions (same cells for every label; summary key common_clean_E2)

rules: REF_ERR, NONDET (ref vs ref#2) and NOOUT cells are excluded from every view; SETUP_ERR cells are excluded and counted per engine.

Cells after the first engine TIMEOUT cell of a notebook are post-timeout cascades: counted separately and excluded from the strict and clean-at-E2 views (the all-comparable view keeps them, so that it equals the per-campaign analysis).
nb_timeout records with summed cell wall_s below 3,600 s are capture-inflated and never engine slowness results.
CRASH/KILLED, MEMORY, TIMEOUT, NOTRUN and ERR cells and nb_crash/nb_memory/nb_timeout records are counted per engine; FALLBACK flags are counted per view.
Operation families are the per-cell `families` recorded by classify (attribute names in the cell's AST); 'finest level reached' = finest L with at least half of the cells conformant at <= L.
caveats: The pilot covers 10 notebooks and is a pilot, not a claim.

Operation families come from attribute names only (e.g. any `.str`/`.dt` access, `.size`, `.agg`); a cell can count in several families, and function calls such as pd.merge(...) count only through their attribute name.

The capture-inflated rule uses recorded cell time only; a notebook can reach the 3,600 s limit through an in-flight cell the record does not contain (native hang), which the rule also labels capture-inflated. The nb_timeout table splits that time for this reason.
Shares pool cells across notebooks, so notebooks with many cells weigh more; the bootstrap resamples notebooks to reflect that clustering.
Engines are converted to pandas with their own conversion before comparison (plan Section 2 confound); capture forces materialisation of lazy engines.

notebooks_excluded.jirakst/book-recommendation: not prepared at 5x: its PandasBench scaling cell calls read_csv(error_bad_lines=...), which pandas 2.0 removed

timing.source: raw timing records (same rule as pconf.timing report)

host_load.window: 1-minute load averages sampled in [start, end + 75 s]; covered = a sample within 90 s before the start and within 90 s after the end, no gap above 150 s

common_clean_E2.definition: cells (notebook, cell index) in the clean_E2 view (post-timeout cascades removed) of every label: conf_1x:pyarrow_backend, conf_1x:modin, conf_1x:fireducks, conf_1x:bodo, conf_1x:dask, drift:p15, drift:p30

bootstrap.unit: notebook (only notebooks holding at least one common cell)
bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5/97.5 of the per-resample difference of pooled DIFF shares

common_clean_E2.reading_rule: about as often: paired 95% interval of the DIFF-share difference contains 0; more often: interval above 0; less often: interval below 0 (fixed 2026-10-05 before the first run)

excluded_inputs.reason: copy of earlier project-level outputs (summary.json, analysis.md), kept for the record
